sources.statusDelta: BreadcrumbList requires ordered ListItem data; the final item may omit item; a typical user path is preferred over a raw URL path.
sources.adoptionDecision: retain shared breadcrumb source for visible trail and JSON-LD

sources.statusDelta: JSON-LD remains the recommended implementation; markup must describe visible page content and does not guarantee a rich result.
sources.adoptionDecision: keep server/source-of-truth boundary and do not claim display eligibility as completion

sources.statusDelta: Practice problem support is being removed from Search reporting and Dataset is documented for Dataset Search rather than Google Search rich results; deprecated feature documentation is removed over time.
sources.adoptionDecision: feed update deltas into the deprecated-type registry and fail closed on removed types

sources.statusDelta: Product snippets and merchant listings have different eligibility boundaries.
sources.adoptionDecision: keep product surface PoC scoped to local source consistency and record search eligibility as unverified

sources.statusDelta: For fast-changing price and availability, structured data in the initial HTML is preferred because JavaScript-only updates can make crawls less frequent and less reliable.
sources.adoptionDecision: keep initial HTML as the preferred product data source while leaving search eligibility and purchase integration unverified

requirementDecision.reason: The refresh tightens source status and verification boundaries already represented by the current SEO/NAV requirements; no new behavior was discovered that warrants a separate requirement ID.
